Caroline / HemoHealth procurement team —

Thanks again for walking through the compliance checklist yesterday. Attached is a concise options matrix for the compliance add-ons you asked about (audit logs, KMS/HSM, data residency, HIPAA support). I pulled the three pricing pathways we typically offer so you can present a single-line budget to finance, plus the workback assumptions. High-level summary below: 

- Audit logs retention: 90d / 365d / 1095d tiers. Pricing modeled as a storage + read-API unit: $0.10 / GB-month (90d), $0.08 / GB-month (365d), $0.06 / GB-month (1095d). We include automated export to S3 for longer-term archival.
- KMS options: bring-your-own-KMS (no charge), Redwood-managed KMS (flat $3,500/month). For HSM-backed keys we offer two patterns: per-tenant dedicated HSM appliance ($12,000/month + one-time integration of $25k) or pooled HSM seats ($2,400/seat/month).
- Data residency: per-region residency surcharge of $1,500/month per region for EU/APAC isolation; US regions are covered in base price. If you need multiple active regional replicas with strict residency and SLA, lockstep is $3,000/month per additional active region.
- HIPAA package: $7,500/month includes BAAs, audit support, increased retention for auditlogs (up to 365d), and quarterly compliance reviews.

Discount / packaging notes:
- We can apply a bundling credit if you commit via a 12-month Dedicated or Hosted consumption commitment. Example: 20% bundled credit on add-ons for a 12-month committed ARR >= $200k, or a 35% credit if you commit to a 24-month reserved capacity path and include HSM.
- One-off onboarding credits: we can waive up to $10k of the integration fee for the first HSM appliance with a 12 month commitment.

Next steps I suggest: 1) Tell me which residency tier(s) you need, 2) confirm whether you want per-seat HSM or dedicated tenant HSM, 3) confirm target finance recipient so I can produce a single-line number for CFO. I attached a compact PDF and SOW draft for procurement.

Quick tech + pricing clarifications to include in Sofia's one-line: 
- Dedicated HSM amortization: one-time $25k integration spread over 36 mo = ~$694/mo; plus $12k/month appliance = $12,694/month nominal. If you need capex-style accounting we can also quote a 36-month capitalized purchase with a smaller monthly OPEX equivalent.

- Residency: EU passive replica surcharge (passive read-only replica) $1,500/month; active multi-region replica would be $3,000/month.

Bundling credit rules: credits apply across add-ons and base usage on an ARR commitment, we can consolidate into a single committed ARR figure. Example we typically net the credit against monthly invoice lines so your procurement sees one number. For the 12-mo path the 20% credit would reduce the add-ons line items (not the one-time integration), and we can top-slice a portion of onboarding credit toward the integration fee.
